decisions.reason: The door-type change applies specifically to the Unit 1 bathroom and does not change Unit 3's door position or kitchen-counter clearance constraint.
Changing the Unit 1 bathroom door from sliding to hinged does not alter Unit 3's kitchen placement or its clearance from the Unit 3 bathroom door.
The candidate's fixture arrangement and door location remain valid; the independently owned door-type change does not replace or invalidate any candidate attribute.
The source changes a Unit 1 bathroom door type but does not change the common bathroom's inclusion, shower placement, completion, or independence from the ensuite.
The Unit 1 door-type change does not affect the Unit 2 bathroom or its centered door-position requirement.
Door type has no necessary effect on toilet, shower, or drain alignment requirements.
The Unit 1 bathroom door-type decision does not alter Unit 3's bathroom requirement or left-wall shower placement.
The candidate already records the source message's separate annotation requests, and changing the Unit 1 door type does not invalidate or modify those dimension-annotation requirements.
The bathroom door-type change does not necessarily alter Unit 1's open-kitchen configuration, cabinet placement, or cabinet lengths.
Changing a bathroom door from sliding to hinged does not resolve or modify the allocation and intended use of the Unit 1 entry area.
The Unit 1 bathroom door type does not change the three-dwelling count or Unit 1's 2+1 configuration.
The source specifies a door-type substitution and does not require any change to the established partition-wall construction or demolition plan.
